title.narrative: SUNREF II Palestine: Sustainable Use of Natural Resources and Energy Finance

description.narrative: The core objective the Action is to support the transition of the Palestinian private sector towards a greener economy, with a primary focus on green energy. The Action aims to stimulate the market for renewable energy, energy efficiency, and other environmental investments by mobilizing the financial sector and other relevant local stakeholders.
